claims_reviewed.claim: A Network Finance.-branded PNet advert for Financial Accountant (Cape Town: Northern Suburbs, ID 4277667; ref NFU017258-Camy-1) was retrievable.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page displays the title, location, Network Finance. advertiser and reference; the separate PNet Western Cape profile 51191 includes the listing in its visible results.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the existence of the agency advert only; Network Finance. is not evidenced as the hiring employer.

claims_reviewed.claim: The role is primarily management/operational finance and business partnering despite the raw Financial Accountant title.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct page describes multi-branch business partnering, performance and variance analysis, operational finance, root-cause work and corrective actions; required experience is 3–5 years in management accounting, operational finance or finance business partnering.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the observed duties and classify provisionally under taxonomy node 9, Management Accounting & Costing; retain the raw title and role-boundary uncertainty.

claims_reviewed.claim: The direct page displays R550,000–R650,000 annually.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The Package & Remuneration section states “R 550000 - R 650000 - Annually.” The displayed range is not annualized from a monthly figure.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the displayed annual range and the R420,000 p.a. screening result; do not infer whether it is base salary, CTC or includes variable pay.

claims_reviewed.claim: The economic R420,000 p.a. salary screen is cleared.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The published lower bound is R550,000 annually, which exceeds R420,000 p.a.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold as a salary-above-floor lead; compensation composition remains unresolved.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The page describes a “leading national services business” but does not provide a hiring-company name; Network Finance. is the advertiser.
claims_reviewed.decision: Reject any employer inference from generic sector wording, location, title, recruiter, profile branding or adjacent PNet recommendations.

claims_reviewed.claim: The employer-side requisition is confirmed to remain open.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct PNet page was retrievable and showed a relative publication age of one week, but no employer confirmation or closing date was displayed. The official Network Recruitment Finance jobs widget returned an error/no cards.
claims_reviewed.decision: Downgrade to “listed on PNet at retrieval”; employer-side acceptance remains unknown. The official-page rendering failure is not proof of vacancy closure.

claims_reviewed.claim: The hiring employer is Boschendal Group, Laurium Capital, or another agreed client.
claims_reviewed.evidence: No end-employer name or agreed-client link appears in the direct advert.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not assign an agreed-client status or promote to agreed-client priority.

claims_reviewed.claim: Network Finance. profile 51191 is the same employer or duplicate source as Network Finance profile 51189.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The PNet profiles use distinct IDs and display names. “Popular jobs” cross-links include other advertisers but do not identify the end employer or establish a duplicate requisition.
claims_reviewed.decision: Keep profile 51191 separate and unmerged pending an official linkage/overlap check.

claims_reviewed.claim: Whether the annual package is base salary, CTC, or includes variable compensation is known.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct page gives an annual range but does not define package composition.
claims_reviewed.decision: Retain the uncertainty; do not relabel the package as base salary.

claims_upheld: A direct PNet Network Finance. advert for Financial Accountant 4277667 existed at retrieval.
The advert displays R550,000–R650,000 annually and describes 3–5-year management/operational finance and business-partnering work.
The displayed annual pay range exceeds the R420,000 p.a. screening floor.
claims_downgraded: The role title is retained as Financial Accountant, but the described remit is more specifically management/operational finance and business partnering; taxonomy assignment remains probable.
A live PNet page does not confirm that the end employer is still accepting applications.
Network Finance. is the agency advertiser, not the identified hiring employer.
No employer identity, agreed-client status, target-company map, candidate map, employer stakeholder or company-email pattern is established.
contradictions: The PNet profile header reports 9 Western Cape results, while the retrieved rendered profile text exposes 8 cards; one result/count discrepancy remains unresolved.
The official Network Recruitment Finance vacancy widget returned an error/no cards; this is an access/rendering limitation, not evidence of no vacancies.
unknowns: End-employer name and employer-side requisition status are unresolved.
Client/agreed-client status is unknown; no Boschendal or Laurium match is evidenced.
No employer-side stakeholder/contact or company-email intelligence can be grounded until the employer is identified.
Whether the displayed annual package is base salary, CTC or includes variable compensation is unstated.
Profile 51191 advertises 9 Western Cape results but only 8 cards were surfaced in retrieved text; the profile inventory discrepancy remains open.
The relationship between the Network Finance. profile 51191 and Network Finance profile 51189 is not verified.
next_research_actions: Seek an agency-origin or employer-origin source that names the hiring employer and confirms employer-side requisition status; do not infer from generic company/sector wording.
Confirm package composition if material to the salary screen.
Reconcile the 9-result profile count with the 8 surfaced direct cards and complete the separate profile overlap review.
Do not begin employer stakeholder/company-email research, target-company mapping or candidate mapping until employer identity is confirmed or high-confidence.
